hypotheses.quote: log a/(b-c) = log b/(c-a) = log c/(a-b)

note: a, b, c positive so the logarithms are defined. Source issue: no real a, b, c satisfy the givens. With each ratio equal to k, any ordering of distinct a, b, c forces a sign contradiction (e.g. a > b > c, k > 0 gives a > 1, c > 1 but b < 1); a = b = c = 1 makes the denominators zero. The claim is therefore vacuous, and validation correctly finds no admissible values.
